_comment: CONFIRMED against a live Betano.ng capture, 21 July 2026 (WNBA: Golden State Valkyries vs Washington Mystics, event 88623579). The Players tab is served by /api/match-odds/{slug}/{eventId}/ with isPlayersToggle=true. Verify these still work after any site change — the shape-hash drift detector (§5.2.5) will flag it.
_leagueCodeNote: CONFIRMED 22 Jul 2026, end-to-end against a real captured payload: this URL's data.blocks[] contains a WNBA block (id 17089, name 'USA - WNBA (W)') whose events[] are real games — parseBetanoFixtures correctly extracted all 7, with real team names, correct near-term dates (matching SofaScore's independently-reported dates to the second), and zero false positives. This replaced /api/sport/basketball/competitions/usa/11326/?sl=440g&req=... — that URL was NEVER directly verified to return this same shape; this one was tested and confirmed. The earlier sl=441g (NBA) vs sl=440g (WNBA) mixup — both basketball, both regionId 11326 — is what silently produced NBA data (including the 'Division Winner - Atlantic/Central/Southeast' phantom fixtures) for this entire debugging session.
_eventPathNote: Each event record carries its own path: /match-odds/{slug}/{id}/ pre-match, /live/{slug}/{id}/ in-play. Substitute it into the template below rather than rebuilding the slug from team names.
_reqParamNote: req= is a field-inclusion list. la,s,stnf,c,mb,mbl returns layout, selections, stats-and-info, competition, market-body and market-body-long. Dropping mbl loses the selection ladders. isPlayersToggle=true is what switches the response to the Players tab.

headers.User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

_marketTypeNote: Type CODES are the reliable key — display names are localised, codes are not. Confirmed for basketball player props.
_marketMapFallback: Used only when a type code is unrecognised.
_milestoneNote: Betano prices these as milestones ('12+' = 12 or more), NOT Over/Under. Since these stats are integers, '12+' is exactly 'Over 11.5', so lines are stored as n-0.5. There is no Under side and no Under price. See src/adapters/betano/matchOdds.ts.
